title: Lockstep ladder and SVF voice banks with a selectable ladder saturator

installed_sdk.rationale: The public signal headers add LadderBank and SvfBank voice banks and a LadderSaturation selector for the ladder filter. This pending source receipt does not establish a released SDK artifact.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: The banks are in-process processor primitives and add no offline timeline command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The banks add no timeline MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: No example or product exposes a new remote control operation; the banks are driven from a processor's own process().

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The bank headers are registered as reviewed infrastructure with no capability keys, so no installed agent capability is added or changed.
